description: Test of the ops core's third stage (core plan S3, N15): a technique card used on a confirmed finding is refused with its reason or grants a saved connection or a session, the PC then shows the compromise marker and opens in the remote view, and unplugging the device ends the session and clears the marker. Nothing to solve.
test_objective: Prove a wrong card is refused with its reason, a finding that grants nothing answers no_grant, the right card with its needs met adds a keyring entry or opens a desktop (on a host that blocks remote sign-in too, only through the foothold it came through), the world marks the compromised PC and clicking it opens the remote view, and unplugging ends the session and clears the marks
